title: The Mural Painter Time Allocation
statement:
A guild of K painters must paint N wooden fence boards with lengths L_1, L_2, ..., L_N.
Each unit length of a board requires T minutes to paint.
Each painter can only be assigned a contiguous segment of boards. Two painters cannot share the same board or swap intermediate boards.

Determine the minimum time (in minutes) required to paint all N boards assuming all K painters work concurrently.
inputFormat:
First line: Three integers N, K, and T.
Second line: N space-separated integers representing board lengths.
outputFormat: Print the minimum time required in minutes.

sampleCases.explanation: Painter 1 paints boards [10, 20, 30] (total length 60, time 60 * 5 = 300). Painter 2 paints board [40] (time 40 * 5 = 200). Max time is 300.
Painter 1 gets 10, Painter 2 gets 20. Max time 20 * 10 = 200.
